correctness.rationale: Reconstructed all odd-characteristic involutions as ±I and q(q+1) nonscalar traceless quadric points u²+vw=1. The identity det(A−V)=d−1+tr(BV) converts forbidden nonscalar V to a plane section <B,V>=(1−d)/2. For B=0 the count is 0 or all q(q+1); for B nilpotent and nonzero the section has 2q (λ=0) or q (λ≠0) solutions; for δ=Q(B)≠0 orthogonal 2-space is split/anisotropic according to χ(δ), giving H=q−χ(δ)+qχ(δ)1_{λ²=δ}. Checking E(A) from the two scalar involutions yields all fibers. A case analysis proves minimum 1 at ±I, second minimum q²−q+1 precisely on nonscalar involutions and two nontrivial Jordan classes; class counts q(q+1)+2(q²−1)=3q²+q−2. Independent exhaustive prime-field checks on F3,F5,F7,F11 reproduce sharp counts and explicit F3 formula; general proof is coordinate-free finite-field conic counting, not finite extrapolation.
